thread:
jess: Heads-up — change window tonight 23:00–01:00 UTC for release v2.3.2. Plan: model bump + feature-flag rollout. Final preflight in ~45m. Need owners for rollback, smoke, and observability.

deploy-bot: Preflight started. Running checks...
deploy-bot: Preflight results:
- infra: ok
- canary infra: ok
- smoke tests: ok
- embed-cost-check: WARNING (threshold=200% current=320%)
Action: advise mitigation for embeddings before full rollout — see dashboard https://dash.internal/r/abc123

kyle: Noted. I'll throttle embedding batch_size in the canary and flip embed-quant flag to int8 for warmup. Plan: canary config update in 10m.

marta: I'll own monitoring. Will set temp alerts to #slo-alerts and enable pager for 00:00–02:00. Will also attach a small playbook in the channel.

samir: Suggested rollback criteria (we should pin these in the checklist):
1) error-rate (5m) > 1% AND increase is sustained 5m
2) p95 latency >= 2x baseline for 10m
3) embeddings cost > 3x baseline for 10m with no traffic anomaly
If triggered -> immediate pin to v2.3.1, stop canary traffic, and page execs.

jess: Agreed. Quick runbook snippet for ops: 
```
# pin previous stable and stop rollout
/deploy pin service-api v2.3.1 --reason "auto-rollback: embed/regression"
/deploy stop-canary cb-<id>
```

kyle: We should also allow a fast-unpin for false positives — manual unpin allowed after 15m post-mitigation and after triage OK.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: id=cb-2025-09-16-01 -> 10% traffic, warmup enabled.
deploy-bot: Canary logs: warmup complete, kv cache hit=98%, tail-latency no regressions so far.

marta: Dashboards and alert templates are up: https://dash.internal/s/v2.3.2-canary

jess: Release notes posted: https://company.internal/releases/v2.3.2 — callout: known warm-up embed cost spike during cold start.

jess: T-minus 30m we'll run a full smoke and then go/no-go. If no objections we'll proceed with progressive rollout.
kyle: +1
samir: +1
marta: +1 :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks all — I'll post a final check at T-minus 5m and pin the rollback owners list in the thread.
